The values on the vertical axis range from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The bars are color-coded, with RECA represented by a light pink color and GAITGAT by a darker pink color. In the Medium frequency category, RECA has a Macro F-score of approximately 0.837, while GAITGAT has a slightly higher score of approximately 0.877. In the Low frequency category, RECA has a Macro F-score of approximately 0.114, and GAITGAT has a significantly lower score of approximately 0.224.
